option_relations.rationale: Chronic anterior blepharitis is a distinct condition and does not directly relate to the provided leaf disease.
TNF-α inhibitor-induced psoriasiform dermatitis is a broader condition and does not specifically match the leaf disease.
TNF-α inhibitor–induced psoriasiform blepharitis could be considered a subtype of drug-induced blepharitis and ectropion associated with TNF-α inhibitors.
Drug-induced blepharitis and ectropion associated with TNF-α inhibitors (infliximab and adalimumab) directly matches the leaf disease.
